title: At the airport
goal: Answer arrival questions and check your gate
freeConversationInstruction: Talk about arriving in a new place, ask travel questions and practise checking details

pages.title: Review the last lesson
pages.instruction: Use a made-up name and number from our contact lesson

pages.title: Name the pictures
pages.instruction: Say each word or expression in English, then click a picture to check and listen

items.audioText: passport. Keep your passport with you.
plane. The plane is over there.

items.example: I need a taxi to the hotel
items.audioText: taxi. I need a taxi to the hotel.

items.example: Our gate is next to the café
items.audioText: gate. Our gate is next to the café.

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’m staying at the Park Hotel
lines.audioText: I’m staying at the Park Hotel.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: And how long are you staying?
lines.audioText: And how long are you staying?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: For three days. Where is gate six?
lines.audioText: For three days. Where is gate six?
lines.translation: Por três dias. Onde fica o portão seis?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: It’s on the left, next to the café
lines.audioText: It’s on the left, next to the café.
lines.translation: Fica à esquerda, ao lado do café

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Thank you. Can you say that again, please?
lines.audioText: Thank you. Can you say that again, please?

questions.answer: Ana is staying at the Park Hotel
Ana is staying for three days
Gate six is on the left, next to the café

pages.title: Share your travel details
pages.instruction: Answer in your own way and ask your teacher a follow-up question

items.cue: Use the hotel on your card

items.prompt: What do you need at the airport?
items.cue: Say what you need, then ask your teacher
items.hint: I need … What do you need?

pages.title: Ask questions with what, where and how long
pages.instruction: Choose the question word, then put is or are before the subject

rows.subject: A thing or detail
rows.example: What is your gate number? What are these documents?

rows.subject: A place
rows.example: Where is the gate? Where are you from?

rows.subject: A length of time
rows.example: How long is the flight? — It’s three hours

pages.note: What asks for information, where asks for a place, and how long asks for duration. What is → What’s; where is → where’s.

pages.title: Use the information to respond
pages.instruction: You’ve arrived. Use your travel card to answer and check details

pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: A new gate. Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! Your gate is different now. Please go to gate eight, not gate six. It’s next to the café. You have time for some water. Keep your passport with you. I’m near the gate. See you there!
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! Your gate is different now. Please go to gate eight, not gate six. It’s next to the café. You have time for some water. Keep your passport with you. I’m near the gate. See you there!
pages.greeting: The gate has changed — here’s the terminal

items.answer: Ana’s new gate is gate eight

items.prompt: What is the new gate next to?
items.answer: The new gate is next to the café

items.prompt: What should Ana keep with her?
items.answer: Ana should keep her passport with her

image.alt: An airport terminal, shared as context for the gate change

pages.title: Respond to the message
pages.instruction: Find the new gate. Use the message to update your response and agree on the next step

pages.title: Watch and answer
pages.instruction: Watch the airport conversation and practise a useful request

items.prompt: What kind of seat would he like?
items.answer: He would like a window seat

items.prompt: Where does he have his boarding pass?
items.hint: Listen when he refuses a paper copy
items.answer: He has it on his phone

items.prompt: How can you ask for a different seat?
items.answer: Example: Can I have a window seat, please?

pages.title: Before next class
pages.instruction: Practise a useful exchange and bring one question

tasks.title: Use it again
tasks.description: Use a made-up hotel and a number of days. Record two answers and one checking question

tasks.title: Ask and respond
tasks.description: Record a short exchange using your own details or the example case. Prepare one follow-up question for your teacher

questions.prompt: What do you want to ask about your gate?
Can you ask me to repeat the gate number?
